description: schemaVersion compatibility behavior of the current implementation (backend/jewelmind/domain/schema.py: schemaVersion: Literal["0.1.0"]). Only one JDL schema version has ever been released, so this matrix intentionally has a single accepted row. It must be extended, never invented ahead of time, when a real 0.2.0 or later schema version is shipped (see docs/bible/05-jdl/081-schema-versioning-and-migrations.md).
